notes.title: Deserter: Prologue – just released for free!
notes.content:
[p]This standalone chapter takes place before the main story of Deserter and gives you early access to the game’s core stealth systems, the dystopian atmosphere of a war-torn city, and a taste of what’s coming next after our first game, Gone Rogue.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Play it now and let us know what you think—we’d love your feedback![/p]
🎮[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688740/Deserter_Prologue/ ] Play the Prologue [/url]

notes.title: Deserter Is Getting a Standalone Prologue — And It’s Coming This August!
notes.content: [p]We’ve been quiet for a while, but that doesn’t mean we’ve been idle. Today, we’re ready to share what we’ve been working on: a free standalone [b]Prologue [/b]for [b]Deserter[/b], launching mid-August![/p][p]This is no teaser or demo. [b]Prologue [/b]is a full-featured chapter that takes place before the events of the main game. It’s designed to give you an early hands-on look at the reworked gameplay, atmosphere, and the evolving world that began with [b]Gone Rogue[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313160/6458b0a853ff5814411dcfe935716b50787f6d04.png"][/img] [/p][p]It’s also a chance to test core systems: controls, environment interaction, stealth mechanics, AI behavior, new items, and skills. Your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions will be invaluable in helping us shape the main game.[/p][p]Add [b]Deserter: Prologue[/b] to your wishlist so you don’t miss the launch — and to help support the project![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688740/Deserter_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Deserter - conceptual sequel to the tactical stealth game Gone Rogue
notes.content:
Welcome to the page of our new stealth game, Deserter!

In this game, we aim to bring to life everything we couldn’t implement in our first game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1803600/Gone_Rogue/]Gone Rogue[/url]. We also strive to incorporate most of our players' feedback and suggestions. The game will take place in the familiar universe of a dark dystopia and the oppression of the all-powerful totalitarian State, but with a new plot and characters (you don’t need to play Gone Rogue to understand the story of Deserter).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313160/d4588320aec7ae452629bb9a4105daf497b35386.png[/img]
Compared to the first installment, the game will feature numerous innovations:
[list]
[*] New break-in methods, new gadgets, and new enemies
[*] Exploration in a semi-open world instead of separate missions
[*] Increased immersion
[*] Survival elements
[*] Character control via keyboard or gamepad
[*] Enhanced graphics, enemy AI, storyline, sound, and music
[/list]
We plan to regularly share updates about these and other new features, so subscribe to our news by clicking the “Follow” button.
